purpose: Teach: 炊い/吹き出し/バリア/しびれ/丸め/きれる/集まら/すりゃ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科の調理実習で、本気で、絶対、お米、絶対、炊いた、絶対、よね
lines.en: Riku, you actually cooked the rice perfectly in home ec. I'm serious.
lines.style: Upbeat, almost teasing. Quick rhythm. Leans forward slightly. Genuine admiration breaking through the surface lightness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。漫画部の、本気で、絶対、吹き出し、絶対、デザイン、絶対、お前、絶対、上手いよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Your manga club speech bubbles are actually really well designed. You've got talent, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, sincere. Soft opening on the agreement. Lands conviction on 'talent' but keeps it casual—not overdoing the praise. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気for、絶対、バリア、絶対、なくて、絶対、何でも、絶対、話せるよ、リク
lines.en: With you, there's no barrier between us. I can talk to you about anything, Riku.
lines.style: Vulnerable but steady. Slower pace. The words cost something. Slight pause before 'anything'—checking that it's safe to say. Soft, genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 長時間、本気で、絶対、勉強で、絶対、足、絶対、しびれる、絶対、ことあるぜ、桜
lines.en: Though I gotta admit, studying for hours straight makes my legs go numb. It happens.
lines.style: Wry, self-deprecating laugh underneath. Lighter tone. Small shrug in the voice. Not complaining—just observing the absurdity of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、紙、絶対、丸めて、絶対、ボール、絶対、作ってたよね、リク
lines.en: Remember when you used to roll up paper into little balls during home ec? Classic you.
lines.style: Affectionate, teasing. Bright energy. Slight laugh in the delivery. Nostalgia mixed with present-moment fondness. Not mean—remembering something that makes her smile.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科の、本気で、絶対、よく、絶対、切れる、絶対、よくきれる、絶対、包丁、絶対、危ないから、絶対、気をつけような、桜
lines.en: The knives in home ec are really sharp, so be careful, okay? I'm serious about that.
lines.style: Protective without being patronizing. Gentle but firm. Opens with concern, lands the warning with quiet weight. Softens at the end—it's care, not a lecture.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活で、本気で、絶対、人が、絶対、集まらない、絶対、日、絶対、寂しいよね、リク
lines.en: Club feels lonely on the days when not many people show up. Doesn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, a little wistful. Slower pace. Trailing off slightly at the end—not sad, but thoughtful. Like she's sharing something she's noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験勉強、本気で、絶対、頑張って、絶対、すりゃ、絶対、絶対、結果が出るぜ、桜
lines.en: If you study hard for the test, you'll get results. You can do this, Sakura.
lines.style: Earnest conviction. Steady, grounded tempo. Lands encouragement with quiet confidence—not hyped, but genuinely believing it. Closes warm.
